theme_strategy.brand_identity: 3 Star Provisional Store (3 ஸ்டார் மளிகை கடை) - Fresh, dependable neighborhood provisional store bringing quality flours (Attai), grains & provisions (Saram), and loose pack staples directly with transparent daily rates.

font_scale.english_sublabel: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider
font_scale.caption: text-xs font-medium

bento_grid_modes.customer_store_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
bento_grid_modes.admin_analytics_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

product_categories.description: Premium quality wheat, rice, gram & millet flours packed fresh daily
High grade rice, pulses, lentils, whole spices & oil packs
Custom quantity loose groceries, seeds, sugar, salt & dry goods

key_components_to_build.name: NavigationHeader
key_components_to_build.description: Sticky top bar with store logo (3 Star Provision), role badge (Admin/User switcher), mobile navigation drawer, cart button with badge counter, Tamil/English brand branding.

key_components_to_build.name: AuthScreen
key_components_to_build.description: Mobile number + Password login card with Role toggle (Owner / Customer demo accounts option), sleek Tamil-welcoming banner.

key_components_to_build.name: CustomerDashboard
key_components_to_build.description: Hero promo section with search bar + active category pill tabs (Attai / Saram / Loose Pack). Product cards displaying Tamil title prominently + English sublabel + rate/unit + dynamic quantity selector (+/-) + Add to Cart.

key_components_to_build.name: CartSheetDrawer
key_components_to_build.description: Slide-out drawer with itemized summary, payment method choice (UPI / Cash on Delivery), address confirmation, and instant order placement.

key_components_to_build.name: AdminDashboard
key_components_to_build.description: Multi-tab panel for Store Owner: 1) Business Analytics (Total Revenue, Net Profit, Total Bills, Avg Order Value), 2) Inventory & Rates Management with quick inline rate and stock editor, 3) Order Management with status dropdown (Pending, Shipped, Delivered) & Payment status marker (Paid/Unpaid), 4) Google Sheets Integration Setup & Live Sync Monitor.

key_components_to_build.name: CustomerAccountOrders
key_components_to_build.description: Tabs for My Orders (status stepper, bill breakdown), My Wishlist, My Payment History (UPI/COD receipts record), Profile & Delivery Address management.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/80 shadow-sm

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, forms, tab switches, cart items, rate edit inputs, order status changers MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Tamil + English dual text format for product names consistently (e.g. கோதுமை மாவு / Wheat Atta).
Keep mobile views priority #1 with easy thumb-zone navigation, sticky cart button, and responsive grids.
Support Google Sheets configuration dialog with simulated or real Apps Script endpoint integration.
Ensure all state updates (Cart, Order Status, Inventory Rates) offer immediate UI feedback using Sonner toast notifications.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML dropdowns.
Ensure high contrast in both light and dark mode with APCA WCAG standards.
Do not use transparent overlays under dropdowns or mobile menus.
Always provide micro-interactions for buttons, tabs, and card hovers.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, tabs, table cells, and status badges.
